setupStep1.title: Set Up Your {appName} Trigger
setupStep1.description: In Zapier, select {appName} as your trigger app and choose the event that should start the automation

setupStep2.title: Write Your System Prompt
setupStep2.description: Tell the AI what you want to do in plain English. The AI will handle all data extraction and validation.
setupStep2.example: Example: 'Send a reminder to the event participant about the upcoming meeting'

setupStep3.title: Select {actionName} as the Action
setupStep3.description: Choose Seasalt.ai's Agentic Send and select {actionName} as your communication channel

setupStep4.title: Input the Data Payload
setupStep4.description: Simply paste the entire JSON output from your trigger. The AI will figure out what to do with it.

setupStep5.title: Test and Activate
setupStep5.description: Test your Zap to make sure everything works, then turn it on. You're done!
